# SetCard

The card for a saved set: name, shape, length, track count, peaks, a mini energy wave, its "Send to TIDAL" state, when it was updated, and Open / Duplicate.

`SongNodes.SetCard` · Music

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.SetCard name="…" shape="…" lengthMin={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.SetCard" name="…" shape="…" length-min="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (SetCardProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Set name. |
| `shape` * | `string` | Set shape ("Peak time three waves"). |
| `lengthMin` * | `number` | Length in minutes. |
| `trackCount` * | `number` | Number of tracks. |
| `peaks` * | `number` | Number of peaks in the energy wave. |
| `wave` * | `number[]` | Energy per slot, 1–10, drawn as the mini wave. |
| `tidal` * | `{ status; label: string }` | "Send to TIDAL" state. |
| `updatedAt` * | `string` | Last updated, ISO. |
| `href` * | `string` | Link to open the set. |
| `onDuplicate` | `() => void` | Duplicate handler. |
